title: Does Vitamin C Stop Colds? What 29 Trials Found
description:
A Cochrane review of 29 trials (11,306 people) found regular vitamin C did not reduce how often most people catch colds. It shortened colds slightly (about 8% in adults, 14% in children). Taking it after symptoms start showed no consistent effect. People under extreme physical stress were the exception.

Sources:
• Hemilä H, Chalker E. Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold. Cochrane 2013: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23440782/
• NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: Vitamin C fact sheet: https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/VitaminC-HealthProfessional/
